name: Daanosaurus
isnote: Described as a bellusaurine brachiosaurid; later work considers it a possible juvenile mamenchisaurid, so its placement is debated.
sum: Daanosaurus is a sauropod known from a juvenile partial skeleton from the Late Jurassic of Sichuan, China, similar to Bellusaurus.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted; the only specimen is a juvenile.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Ye et al. 2005

sources.text: Xing, Lida 2013. A new basal eusauropod from the Middle Jurassic of Yunnan, China, and faunal compositions and transitions of Asian sauropodomorph dinosaurs. Acta Palaeontologica Polonica. doi:10.4202/app.2012.0151
